operations.query_signature: There are $K\ge2$ experts with losses $\ell_t:[K]\to[0,1]$ fixed in advance. Choose $I_t$ before observing the complete current loss vector. Neighboring streams differ in one whole loss vector. The hindsight best expert loss $L_\star=\min_i\sum_t\ell_t(i)$ is unknown. Inputs $K,T,\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}}$ are public. The infimum is over the mechanism class in Condition 4.1 of the source, not all private expert algorithms. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

source_fields.base_expression: $$R_T=\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(I_t)-\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(i),\qquad L_\star=\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(i).$$ This is cumulative external regret, not divided by $T$. Privacy separately constrains the specified released record.
source_fields.normalization: Use the cumulative quantity over T rounds without dividing by T. Preserve the displayed order of probability or expectation.
source_fields.finiteness_conditions: Both cumulative losses lie in [0,T], so their difference on each execution path lies in [-T,T].

$$\mathbb E\!\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_t(I_t)-\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_t(i)\right].$$ Take the infimum over the restricted algorithm class and the supremum over fixed loss streams. One complete vector is revealed per round, with $N=T$; the resampling record is public. Count information calls, arithmetic, communication rounds, and memory separately. Unrestricted exact-real internal work is excluded from information complexity, which therefore implies no bit bound. Exploration, initialization, and identification all count toward the online budget. The joint resource statement does not certify optimal arithmetic or bit complexity.
